title: Setting rootPath on HierarchicalMenu shows up in CurrentRefinements
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

Setting rootPath on HierarchicalMenu shows up in CurrentRefinements

## 🔍 Bug reproduction

**Steps to reproduce the behavior:**

1. See that rootPath is set on HierarchicalMenu
2. Add another facet refinement by clicking a brand
3. Click the clear refinements button
4. See error, the rootPath now shows up in the CurrentRefinements and ClearRefinements widgets, and it's also showing in the URL.

**Live reproduction:**

https://codesandbox.io/s/wild-smoke-5m42st?file=/App.tsx

## 💭 Expected behavior

Refinement passed as rootPath to HierarchicalMenu should be invisible for the user. This is how it works in the non-hooks version.

## Environment

* React InstantSearch Hooks version: 6.38.1
